scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Senja
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Wachau Danube Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-kalkalpen-wilder-graben-traismaue.story: From Reichraming it runs 389 km to Reichraming; allow about 6 h 42 of riding.
